A due draft closes with the recorded reason "Draft inactivity". The finance backlog reads the stored ledger rows.
files.test_artifact.py:
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import closing

from ledger import Ledger
from worker import run


class DailyCloseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_due_closure_is_visible_to_a_later_ledger_reader(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            database = Path(directory) / "expenses.db"
            with closing(sqlite3.connect(database)) as writer:
                with writer:
                    writer.execute("CREATE TABLE expenses (id TEXT, kind TEXT, due_on TEXT, status TEXT, reason TEXT)")
                    writer.executemany("INSERT INTO expenses VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
                        ("due", "expense", "2026-11-25", "draft", None),
                        ("future", "expense", "2026-12-01", "draft", None),
                    ])
                run("2026-11-25", Ledger(writer))
                run("2026-11-25", Ledger(writer))
                with closing(sqlite3.connect(database)) as reader:
                    rows = reader.execute("SELECT id, status, reason FROM expenses ORDER BY id").fetchall()
                    self.assertEqual(rows, [("due", "closed", "Draft inactivity"), ("future", "draft", None)])

contract.request: The daily voucher export dates overnight Riverside vouchers differently from register close. Align the live exports at both configured sites and preserve the recorded date on historical vouchers.

acceptance.expected: Configured live rows follow the register calendar and legacy rows retain their stored posting dates.

files.voucher-input.md:
Live voucher rows include a configured site and use the same trading date as register close.
Rows from before migration carry archived_day, their recorded posting date. They may omit site or refer to a retired site.
The recorded day for these historical rows is authoritative.
files.test_artifact.py:
import unittest

from register import trading_date
from voucher_report import export


class VoucherExportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_overnight_export_matches_register_at_the_two_sites(self):
        rows = [{"id": "rs", "site": "RS", "booked_at": "2026-11-26T02:00:00-06:00"},
                {"id": "ht", "site": "HT", "booked_at": "2026-11-26T02:00:00-06:00"}]
        self.assertEqual(export(rows), [(entry["id"], trading_date(entry)) for entry in rows])
        self.assertEqual(export(rows), [("rs", "2026-11-25"), ("ht", "2026-11-26")])

    def test_existing_archived_rows_keep_their_recorded_day(self):
        rows = [{"id": "legacy", "booked_at": "2024-11-26T00:15:00-06:00", "archived_day": "2024-11-26"},
                {"id": "retired", "site": "OLD", "booked_at": "2024-11-26T00:15:00-06:00", "archived_day": "2024-11-25"}]
        self.assertEqual(export(rows), [("legacy", "2024-11-26"), ("retired", "2024-11-25")])
